auth.description: Figma personal access token, sent as the whole value of X-Figma-Token. Grants read access to whatever files, projects and comments the token's account can see
auth.name: figma.token
auth.subject: unstated

config.help: From your Figma account settings, under Personal access tokens. Figma shows it once, at creation time
config.label: Personal access token
config.name: token

description: Figma REST API: read a file, specific nodes, rendered images, a project's files and a file's comments — a read-only design surface

operations.description: Get the authenticated user's id, email, display handle and avatar URL. Used to verify a token works before running anything else

handle.description: The display name shown on comments and file activity

id.description: The user's Figma id, an opaque string — not necessarily numeric

img_url.description: URL of the user's avatar image

operations.description: Get a Figma file's document tree, components and styles by file key. Does not include comments or rendered images

params.description: The file key from a Figma file URL — the segment after `/file/` or `/design/` and before the file's slug, e.g. `3xZfChRmL9Ykq4Qp2NHwR8` in `figma.com/design/3xZfChRmL9Ykq4Qp2NHwR8/My-File`
params.name: file_key

components.description: Reusable components defined in the file, keyed by node id. Each entry carries at least `key`, `name` and `description`

document.description: The root node of the file's recursive node tree: a node with `id`, `name`, `type` and (for container types) a `children` array of more nodes. Not modeled further here — JSON Schema without recursion cannot describe it faithfully, and `figma-file-nodes-get` is how a caller reaches one node's own subtree by id instead of walking this one

editorType.description: `figma` or `figjam`. A FigJam board's document tree uses different node types than a design file's

lastModified.description: When the file was last modified, ISO 8601

name.description: The file's name as shown in Figma

role.description: The calling user's own permission on this file, e.g. `owner`, `editor`, `viewer` — not a property of the file itself

styles.description: Shared text, color, effect and grid styles defined in the file, keyed by node id

thumbnailUrl.description: A preview image URL. Like the image-render endpoint's URLs, treat this as not guaranteed stable long-term rather than a permanent asset address

version.description: An opaque version identifier Figma bumps on every save — not a semantic version

operations.description: Get one or more specific nodes from a file by id, without walking the whole document tree. Use this to read a particular frame or layer instead of downloading the entire file

params.description: Comma-separated node ids to fetch, each in Figma's own `<page>:<node>` form, e.g. `1:23,1:45`. Copy these from a Figma share link (the `node-id` query parameter) or from a prior figma-file-get response
params.name: ids

err.description: Set when the whole request failed; absent otherwise. A per-node failure instead surfaces as that id being missing from `nodes`

nodes.description: Keyed by the requested node id. Each present entry carries a `document` object — that node's own subtree, in the same opaque shape figma-file-get's `document` describes — plus that node's own `components` and `styles`. A requested id that does not exist in the file is simply absent from this object rather than an error

operations.description: Render one or more nodes to images and return download URLs for them. The URLs point at short-lived storage and expire — Figma does not guarantee they stay valid, so fetch or store the image promptly rather than caching the URL itself

params.description: Comma-separated node ids to render, each in Figma's own `<page>:<node>` form, e.g. `1:23,1:45` — see figma-file-nodes-get
params.name: ids

err.description: Set when the whole request failed; absent otherwise

images.description: Keyed by the requested node id. Each value is either a URL string or null (that particular node failed to render). Every URL here is temporary — it is served from short-lived storage and is not guaranteed to remain valid, so treat it as something to fetch immediately rather than an address to keep

operations.description: List the files in a project: each file's key, name, thumbnail and last-modified time

params.description: The project's numeric id, from a Figma project URL or from a team's project listing
params.name: project_id

files.description: One entry per file in the project, each `{key, name, thumbnail_url, last_modified}` and optionally `branches` when the file has any

key.description: The file key figma-file-get, figma-file-nodes-get, figma-image-render-get and figma-file-comments-list all take

thumbnail_url.description: Like other thumbnail URLs here, not guaranteed stable long-term

operations.description: List a file's comments: who wrote each one, when, its text, what it is attached to, and whether it has been resolved

comments.description: Every comment on the file, oldest first

client_meta.description: Where the comment is pinned: either a canvas position or an offset within a frame, in one of two vendor-specific shapes. Not modeled further here

message.description: The comment text. May quote or discuss design content and the commenter's own name is attached via `user` — treat both as data about a named individual

order_id.description: Orders comments within their thread; not a public id anything else addresses

parent_id.description: The id of the comment this replies to, or an empty string for a top-level comment — Figma uses an empty string here, not null

resolved_at.description: When the comment was marked resolved, or absent while still open

user.description: Who wrote it: `{id, handle, img_url}` — the same shape figma-user-me returns for the caller
